description:
Create a text layer with content, position, font, and optional typography (tracking, leading, paragraph box, alignment, color).

Users often say: add title, letter spacing, line height, text box, 字间距, 行高, 排版.

Use when: adding labels, titles, or typography to the design.
Do NOT use when: editing existing text — use photoshop_update_text_content / photoshop_set_text_style.
Do NOT use execute_script for tracking/leading/box — pass those fields here.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layerName, text, style, context } }.
Use photoshop_list_fonts to discover font names; photoshop_set_text_font / photoshop_set_text_style to change later.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds text layer.

auto_leading.description: Use Photoshop auto leading (ignores leading when true)

box_height.description: Paragraph text box height in pixels (implies kind=paragraph)

box_width.description: Paragraph text box width in pixels (implies kind=paragraph)

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

fontName.description: Optional font display or PostScript name (resolved via app.fonts; see photoshop_list_fonts)

kind.description: point = single-line; paragraph = wrapped text box (default point unless box_width/height set)

leading.description: Line height in points. Sets auto_leading false.

tracking.description: Character spacing in 1/1000 em (−1000 to 10000). Photoshop tracking.

name: photoshop_create_text_layer
